description:
About the Scholarship

DENSYS trains engineers for decentralised smart energy systems across Université de Lorraine, KTH, UPC and Politecnico di Torino. The 2026 round closed on 26 January at 18:00 Paris time, and the 2027 round is expected to use the same date for its scholarship applications.

OpportunityDENSYS – Erasmus Mundus Master in Decentralised Smart Energy Systems
HostDENSYS Consortium (Université de Lorraine)
LocationNancy (multi-country mobility), France
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
StipendErasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students:
Application Deadline26 January 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

DENSYS trains engineers for decentralised smart energy systems across Université de Lorraine, KTH, UPC and Politecnico di Torino. The 2026 round closed on 26 January at 18:00 Paris time, and the 2027 round is expected to use the same date for its scholarship applications.

Programme Highlights

  • Energy-transition engineering with mobility through four technical universities
  • Late-January scholarship deadline pattern (26 January, 18:00 Paris time)
  • DENSYS 2.0 edition continuing under renewed EU funding
  • Graduates enter grid services, energy storage and distributed-generation careers

Who Should Apply

Energy, electrical and mechanical engineering graduates with thermodynamics and power-systems basics are the core audience.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs plus monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the DENSYS site and target the late-January cut-off with certified documents ready. Key deadline information: 26 January 2027 (18:00 Paris time, expected — mirrors the 2026 round).

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About DENSYS Consortium (Université De Lorraine)

The DENSYS consortium is coordinated by Université de Lorraine and delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Decentralised Smart Energy Systems with KTH, UPC and Politecnico di Torino.

Official website: https://densys.univ-lorraine.fr

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 26 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

Application guides

  • University Motivation Letter: Explain Your Preparation and Course Choice
  • A 12-Month Study Abroad Application Plan for Master's and PhD Applicants
